[D23:11] James: Cool! I hope the new devices will improve your skill and you will play even better!
[D23:11] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a video game scene of a couple of people

[D23:17] James: Thanks for your support, John! I really appreciate it. I hope I can treat you to my creation once I learn a little more about cooking.
[D23:18] John: I look forward to it, James, you can do it!
[D23:19] James: Your words give me even more strength to pursue my new hobby!
[D23:20] John: That's why we are friends, to support each other! Well, I have to go, bye!
[D23:21] James: Take care, John, bye!
Session date: 6:02 pm on 18 September, 2022

[D24:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a table with a laptop and a game on it

[D24:4] James: Thanks, John! I get them from various sources like books, movies, and even dreams.
[D24:5] John: Wow, dreams have inspired you? That's interesting. Have any specific dreams guided your ideas?

[D24:7] John: Wow, dreams can be so awesome! Are there any specific details you remember from that one?
[D24:8] James: I remember there was a medieval castle with its own labyrinth full of puzzles and traps. It felt like playing a video game in real life!
[D24:9] John: Wow, exploring a castle with puzzles and traps sounds awesome! Have you got any sketches or notes from that experience? I'd love to take a look!
[D24:10] James: Yep! I made some sketches and notes. Hang on, let me grab them.
[D24:10] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a notepad with a drawing of a guitar
[D24:11] John: Nice sketch! Do you like music, or is it related to your castle dream?
[D24:12] James: Thanks! Music is a big part of my life - nothing to do with castles though. What kind of music do you like? Do you play any instruments?
[D24:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a desk with a laptop, headphones, and a monitor
[D24:13] John: Cool! I'm into electronic and rock music. I used to play drums when I was younger, but haven't in a while. Do you play any instruments?
[D24:14] James: Yeah, rock's awesome! I used to play a guitar when I was younger but haven't in a while.
[D24:15] John: Playing drums when I was younger was a fun way to let off steam. Here's a photo of an old drum set I used to play on.
[D24:15] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a drum set up in a recording studio
[D24:16] James: Cool! Have you ever been in a band or just jammed with friends?
[D24:17] John: I've jammed with friends before, it was a lot of fun!
[D24:18] James: Sounds awesome! Jamming with friends is always a blast. Do you have any recordings or videos of those sessions?
[D24:19] John: Nah, it was more about the experience and the moment. No recordings or videos from the jams.
[D24:20] James: No problem! It's nice to just enjoy the experience without worrying about collecting videos or recordings. By the way, I started streaming games. No details yet, I hope everything works out.
[D24:21] John: I'll keep my fingers crossed for you! You will definitely succeed, I look forward to the details!
Session date: 8:56 pm on 20 September, 2022

Session date: 9:18 pm on 26 August, 2022

[D21:3] James:  His name's Ned and he's been awesome since I adopted him. I can't imagine life without him. It's great to hear that your siblings signed up for programming.
[D21:4] John: That's right, his name is Ned, how could I forget?!
[D21:5] James: Regarding your siblings, are you already working on anything cool with them?
[D21:6] John: Yeah! We're working on a cool project together that involves coding. It's a game and it's helping them learn.
[D21:7] James: Wow, learning and gaming sounds like a fantastic combination for coding education! Can you share more details about the game?

As for me, I've been trying out different genres of games and now I'm dying to create a strategy game like Civilization - love how complicated and in-depth they are. Fingers crossed, one day I'll make my own awesome strategy game!
[D21:10] John: Wow, James, that's impressive! It's gonna be awesome. Can't wait to see what you come up with!
[D21:11] James:  Are you free tomorrow?
[D21:12] John: Yes, tomorrow is my day off. Do you have any suggestions on how to spend tomorrow?
[D21:13] James: Yes, we can go to Starbucks for coffee if you want.
[D21:13] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a laptop computer with a colorful keyboard on a table

[D21:15] James: Well, how about we go to McGee's pub then? I heard they serve a great stout there!
[D21:16] John: Great idea, except I don't like dark beer. Maybe there's something else there?
[D21:17] James: Of course, there are also light beers!
[D21:18] John: Great, then I agree! See you tomorrow at McGee's Pub!
[D21:19] James: See you John, bye!
Session date: 6:53 pm on 1 September, 2022
[D22:1] James: Hey John! Been a while, but hope you're doing well. My Unity strategy game is finally finished—it took loads of time and effort, but I'm really proud. Your support and encouragement made a real difference. Thanks for believing in me!
[D22:1] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a screenshot of a stone building with a giant creature
[D22:2] John: Hey James! Congrats on finishing your game! It looks amazing and I'm so proud of you for all the hard work you put in. Can I see more of it? Got any other screenshots to show me?
[D22:3] James: I appreciate your support. Check out this screenshot from it.
[D22:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a video game screen showing a person on a horse
[D22:4] John: This game looks great! What inspired you to create it?
[D22:5] James: I've always loved playing strategy games like Civilization and Total War, so I decided to challenge myself and create one of my own.
[D22:6] John: That's awesome! I love those games too. It must have been quite an experience making your own. Did you face any difficulties during development?
[D22:7] James: It was a bit challenging to get everything right, balancing mechanics and ensuring fairness. But with some trial and error, I managed to get it to where I wanted it.
[D22:8] John: Wow, that must have been a challenge, especially since you had to make sure the game was enjoyable and balanced. Congratulations on completing it! What were some key takeaways from the experience?
[D22:9] James: Thanks, John! It was definitely a learning experience. Perseverance and patience are key, and I'm proud of what I created after sticking with it. Also, feedback and collaboration are essential, and the help from others really made the game better. It was great!
[D22:10] John: Awesome that you learned those lessons! Collaboration and feedback make a huge impact on any project. I've been teaching my siblings coding. It's been a fulfilling experience and they're already creating their own programs - amazing!
[D22:11] James: Wow, John! Cool seeing others learn with your help. What kind of programs are they making?
[D22:12] John: They're starting small, making basic games and stories. It's inspiring how fast they learn and the good time they're having.
[D22:13] James: Wow! It's inspiring how fast they learn and the good time they're having. I bet they'll be creating their own complex projects soon!
[D22:14] John: I'm excited to see how far they can go! With their passion for video games like me, hopefully they can use those coding skills to make something cool. I'm so proud of them, can't wait to see what they come up with!
[D22:15] James: I'm proud of them too! Seeing the next generation pick up coding and making their own games is awesome. Can't wait to see what they create!
[D22:16] John: Thanks, James, for the support. I really appreciate it.
[D22:17] James: Yeah, you're the best! I'm here for you, no doubt.
[D22:18] John:  Your friendship really means a lot. I'm going through some difficult times now and it's really good to know I've got someone like you.
[D22:19] James: Just know I'm here if you need someone to talk or vent to. It might help alleviate some of the difficult times you're going through.

Session date: 9:49 am on 22 July, 2022
[D17:1] John: Hi James! I just started playing chess to get better at strategy. I'm loving it! Have you ever tried it out?
[D17:2] James: Hey John! Yeah, I've played chess before. It's a game that really tests your strategy. It's great that you're enjoying it!
[D17:3] John: Yeah, chess is really fun! It's like solving an endless puzzle and always trying to outwit your opponent.
[D17:4] James: Yeah, it's tough, but fun when you figure it out. Do you play with friends or online?
[D17:5] John: I'm playing mostly online for now, but I also joined a chess club and practice with others. Here's a pic from an intense game I played lately.
[D17:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a chess board with a laptop on it
[D17:6] James: Wow, looks intense! What sparked your interest in chess?
[D17:7] John: I've always been drawn to strategy games and wanted to challenge myself. Plus, I believe chess can improve decision-making skills.
[D17:8] James: Great reason for playing chess - it will definitely help you develop your skills!
[D17:9] John: Thanks, James! I'm excited to see how playing chess can enhance my strategic thinking in everyday situations. Do you have any tips for improvement?
[D17:10] James: Definitely! Studying opening moves and strategies and analyzing your games to spot weaknesses are great ways to improve.
[D17:11] John:  I'll definitely look into that. Appreciate the advice!
[D17:12] James: No worries, John! Happy to help. Just let me know if there's anything else I can assist you with.
[D17:13] John:  Your support means a lot to me. You're a true friend! Remember this photo from elementary school?
[D17:13] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of children holding a skateboard
[D17:14] James: That looks fun. But I don’t remember at all under what circumstances we took this picture. What's the story behind it?
[D17:15] John: This is from when we were 10 and we were really into skateboarding. We had a group of friends who often go to the skate park with. We would help each other learn new tricks and have a great time. Those friends made the experience even better and their friendship meant a lot to us.
[D17:16] James: Indeed, I remember this moment. We loved skateboards back then, sometimes we even left class early to do it. I still like to go for a ride sometimes, and I even taught my dogs how to balance on it.
[D17:16] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a small dog standing on a skateboard
[D17:17] John: Wow! Do they enjoy it, or do you have to encourage them to play with the board?
[D17:18] James: They love it! They chase after it and run with it. It's a great way for them to get some exercise.
[D17:19] John: Wow, that's great! Keeping active and happy is great for both of you.
[D17:20] James: Yep! Staying active with them builds a strong bond and makes us both happy.
[D17:21] John: Yeah, the bond between us and our pets is amazing. They bring a lot of joy and love. It’s a pity that I don’t have pets, I’ll definitely get one someday. By the way, how was your trip?
[D17:21] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a cat laying on a bed with a stuffed animal
[D17:22] James: Everything went great! In addition, I even managed to get out to another country. The city of Nuuk, if you know. I stayed there quite a bit, but at least I had one more country to add to my bucket list!
[D17:23] John: This is awesome, James! Surely you brought a lot of impressions with you!
[D17:24] James: Certainly! And not only impressions, I also brought souvenirs. For both you and your Jill!
[D17:25] John: Thank you very much, Jill will be delighted!
[D17:26] James: You're welcome! By the way, look who came to see me!
[D17:26] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman and two dogs on a couch
[D17:27] John: Nice pic, James! Who are they?
[D17:28] James: That's my sister and my dogs. We were just chilling together yesterday, and they bring so much happiness to my life.
[D17:29] John: Wow, they look so happy! It's awesome that you get to spend time with your sister and your furry friends. The bond you have with them is really strong.
[D17:30] James: I'm blessed to have a close bond with my sister and our furry friends. We have a great time together, like a family!
[D17:31] John: Family and friends are really amazing, James. They show us so much love and joy. I'm grateful for the connection I have with my siblings. Things can be tough sometimes, but their support means everything to me.
[D17:32] James: Fully agreed! My sister and I were also near the ocean and watched such a wonderful sunset!
[D17:32] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard
[D17:33] John: Wonderful photo! It's amazing how you can capture a moment and capture it in a photograph.
[D17:34] James: Thanks, John! This is just a good shot, nothing more. I took a lot of shots yesterday and chose the best one to send to you.
[D17:35] John: Still, the photo is amazing!
[D17:36] James: I have to go, I'm tired over the last two days. Bye!
[D17:37] John: Take care, bye!

[D12:14] John: No worries, I'm here to help. Keep going and reach those goals!
Session date: 4:30 pm on 13 June, 2022

[D13:2] James: Hey John! Awesome to hear from you. Yeah, a lot has happened. Let's catch up!
[D13:3] John: I finally got my dream job! After lots of interviews and late nights, I got the offer and was ecstatic. Can't wait to start my journey!
[D13:4] James: Wow, John! Congrats on getting your dream job. I'm super stoked for you. When do you start?
[D13:5] John: Thank you! ! I'm starting next month.
[D13:6] James: It can be rough getting started, but I'm sure you'll do great. Don't be afraid to seek help if you need it. Can't wait to hear about your experience! By the way, I recently started a course that combines my passion for gaming and programming. It's fun and challenging, and it has definitely increased my excitement for both.
[D13:7] John: Cool! That sounds awesome. Combining your love of gaming and coding sounds like a dream. Tell me more! Are there any interesting projects you're working on?
[D13:8] James: Yes, we are currently working on a new part of the football simulator. I was working on collecting player databases. It wasn't easy, but I did it!

[D13:14] James: Absolutely! They are forever in my heart, they are a great team. I hope they become champions next season!
[D13:15] John: As a Manchester City fan, I can't agree with you. You'll see, our two teams will fight for the championship, and mine will win!

[D13:17] John: You may be right, but the City manager can handle it, you'll see!
[D13:18] James: I bet we'll be higher than you in the final standings!
[D13:19] John: I'll take the bet, James! This will be a great battle!
[D13:20] James: Sure, John!
Session date: 5:07 pm on 16 June, 2022
